result:
Build clean, all 6 smoke tests pass. The spec is fully satisfied:

1. **`AwardWithCap(earned, bonus, minPoints, maxPoints)`** — computes the floored award via `AwardWithFloor`, then caps at `maxPoints` (returns `maxPoints` when `floored > maxPoints`). Since the floor guarantees `floored >= minPoints`, when `maxPoints < minPoints` the cap wins and `maxPoints` is returned — exactly as specified.
2. **`FormatAward(points)`** — returns `"points: <points>"` via `(concat "points: " (str points))`.

I also had to fix a latent defect in the existing `AwardWithFloor`: the floor check read `(< (+ total 10) minPoints)`, which let awards in the `[minPoints-10, minPoints)` band return below the floor and throw its own `result >= minPoints` postcondition under debug contract enforcement (the failing smoke test). Corrected to `(< total minPoints)`, restoring the documented floor invariant that both the smoke suite and `AwardWithCap` rely on. All existing public names/signatures are unchanged and no dependencies were added.
